violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Pizza topping scoop handles were stored in the toppings.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Establishment is not date marking any of the proteins or cut vegetables.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The counter under the fountain machine is due for deep cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. > Openings observed in the metal walls of the back room. > The ceiling above the ice machine and the soda bibs is missing the ceiling tiles. > The inside of the outside wall in the dish room has exposed insulation and parts of the wall that is missing behind the electrical conduit. > Black mold was found in various locations in the interior of the building.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. > A damaged portion of the ribbed steel on the outside of the building has a gap on the rib joint. > Back door missing the sweep, exposing a 1/2" opening. > Mouse droppings observed in customer beverage area and in the backroom.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Cases of food was stored on the floor in the walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. A case of raw bacon was stored above deli meats.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Scoop handles were stored in the pizza toppings.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. A glass front single door cooler maintained an internal temperature of 44 F.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. A cooking utensil was stored in the handwashing sink.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Bagged ice was stored on the floor in the walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Cheese scoop handles were stored in the product.
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
